zh.sequenceFlow: 序列特征 → 候选优先级
zh.exampleIntro: 从12条示例序列出发，探索不同研究方向下的候选排序与特征解释。
zh.filterBody: 结合序列特征和评分依据，组织适合后续验证的候选清单。
zh.detailTitle: 让每一次排序，都有可读的依据。

zh.methodOneBody: 覆盖ACE抑制、抗氧化、抗菌、抗炎、DPP-IV抑制、α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制及广谱活性探索，按研究目标查看候选特征。
zh.methodTwoBody: 整合长度、端基、残基组成、疏水比例和电荷等特征，呈现逐条评分依据，帮助研究者建立候选优先级。
zh.methodThreeBody: 提供筛选结果CSV与完整示例JSON，保留描述符、规则依据和来源指纹，衔接后续实验设计与研究记录。
zh.methodData: 本站使用12条人工指定的示例序列，展示本地程序预计算的理化描述符和0–100规则优先级。分数用于候选排序，活性效应由对应实验评价。
zh.methodMetric: 分子质量采用未修饰线性肽的中性单同位素质量；净电荷按pH 7计算。示例包含规则评分与描述符，机器学习预测、实验IC₅₀和对接结果属于独立分析流程。
zh.methodBrand: 校徽来源：桂林医科大学官网“校徽校旗”。本页为研究项目演示。

en.heroTitle: Read the sequence. Discover research potential.

en.heroNote: Seven research directions · Molecular descriptors · Export-ready results

en.filterBody: Combine sequence features and scoring explanations to organize a focused candidate list for validation.
en.detailTitle: A clear rationale behind every ranking.
en.detailLead: Explore composition, terminal residues and molecular properties to understand each candidate’s priority.
en.selectDetail: Select a candidate above to explore its features.
en.methodsTitle: Turn sequence features into research leads.
en.methodOneBody: Browse ACE inhibition, antioxidant, antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, DPP-IV inhibition, α-glucosidase inhibition and general bioactivity priorities.
en.methodTwoBody: Connect length, termini, residue composition, hydrophobicity and charge with per-sequence explanations for research prioritization.
en.methodThreeBody: Export filtered CSV results or the full example JSON, including descriptors, scoring explanations and source fingerprints for research records.
en.methodData: This explorer presents 12 manually selected example sequences with precomputed molecular descriptors and rule-based priorities on a 0–100 scale. Scores support candidate ranking; corresponding experiments establish activity effects.
en.methodMetric: Mass is the neutral monoisotopic mass of an unmodified linear peptide; charge is calculated at pH 7. Examples contain rule scores and descriptors. Machine-learning predictions, experimental IC₅₀ and docking results belong to separate analysis workflows.
en.methodBrand: Emblem source: Guilin Medical University official website, University Emblem and Flag. This page is a research-project demonstration.
en.methodFooter: Keep candidates, features and explanations together for informed research decisions.
